title: Published blowhorn-site release that cuts a desktop build
description: The public GitHub release tag on blowhorn-ai/blowhorn-site that triggers a desktop cut. It is vX.Y.Z (optional prerelease suffix), the same tag customers download as, not desktop-vX.Y.Z (that tag lives on the private product repository) and not axi-vX.Y.Z (blowhorn-axi).

tag_name.description: Public release tag, for example v2.15.0 or v2.15.0-beta.1.
